cloudOff.name: thread_forget
cloudOff.description: Drops a thread (by id, or a prefix of it) no turn ever ran on: the row a launch that never got going leaves in threads and in the person's sidebar goes, and nothing is asked of the machine. A launch the agent refused outright, for want of a sign-in, counts as one that ran nothing and goes the same way. Refused in one line once a turn of the thread did work, since that work is written down on it and nowhere else; delete takes a thread that ran, with its turns.

thread.description: the thread's id, or a prefix of it that names one, as threads lists them
